ACC_COMMINGLED_01.explanation_text:
Account 'ACC_COMMINGLED_01' Consensus Lien Assessment:
  - Proportional Tracing: ₹35,854.34 (3,585,434 paise)
  - FIFO Tracing:         ₹40,000.00 (4,000,000 paise)
  - LIBR Tracing:         ₹75,000.00 (7,500,000 paise)
  -> Consensus Bounds: Lower = ₹35,854.34 | Upper = ₹75,000.00
  -> Method Disagreement Range: ₹39,145.66 (3,914,566 paise)
